title: Private City Tour of the Los Angeles Area
blurb:
Private tour with up to 5 passengers in your own private mini van. 

Our recommended route is : Downtown LA, The Music Center of Los Angeles, The Walt Disney Concert Hall, Hollywood, Movie Stare Homes, Hollywood Walk of Fame, Beverly Hills, Rodeo Drive, Lunch at the world famous original Farmers Market, Korea town, Los Angeles, The Staples arena. 
4.5 Hours

Option to fully customize where you go & what you see
 • 

Expert guide can develop an itinerary of sites for you
 • 

Chance to explore iconic Los Angeles & Hollywood landmarks
 • 

Fun & worry free experience to be had with private group
